select jsonb_build_object(
'functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'signature',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',
 'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),
 'acl',p.proacl::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,
 'language',l.lanname,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,
 'config',p.proconfig) order by n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)),'[]')
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang
 where p.prokind in ('f','p') and n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 and not exists(select 1 from pg_depend d where d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass and d.objid=p.oid and d.deptype='e')),
'relations',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relacl,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.reloptions) order by n.nspname,c.relname),'[]') from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),
'columns',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnum,a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),a.attacl) order by n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum),'[]') from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid=c.oid left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=c.oid and d.adnum=a.attnum where a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped and n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),
'constraints',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,'name',x.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(x.oid)) order by n.nspname,c.relname,x.conname),'[]') from pg_constraint x join pg_class c on c.oid=x.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),
'indexes',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,pg_get_indexdef(c.oid)) order by n.nspname,c.relname),'[]') from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where c.relkind='i' and n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),
'policies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,p.polname,p.polcmd,p.polpermissive,(select array_agg(case when r=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_get_userbyid(r) end order by r) from unnest(p.polroles) r),pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)) order by n.nspname,c.relname,p.polname),'[]') from pg_policy p join pg_class c on c.oid=p.polrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace),
 'triggers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) order by n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname),'[]') from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where not t.tgisinternal),
 'namespaces',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(nspname,pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),nspacl) order by nspname) from pg_namespace where nspname not like 'pg_%' and nspname<>'information_schema'),
 'defaults',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),coalesce(n.nspname,''),d.defaclobjtype,d.defaclacl::text) order by pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),coalesce(n.nspname,''),d.defaclobjtype),'[]') from pg_default_acl d left join pg_namespace n on n.oid=d.defaclnamespace),
 'roles',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolconnlimit,rolvaliduntil,rolconfig) order by rolname) from pg_roles),
 'memberships',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(roleid),pg_get_userbyid(member),pg_get_userbyid(grantor),admin_option,inherit_option,set_option) order by pg_get_userbyid(roleid),pg_get_userbyid(member),pg_get_userbyid(grantor)),'[]') from pg_auth_members),
 'views',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true)) order by n.nspname,c.relname),'[]') from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where c.relkind in ('v','m') and n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),
 'rules',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,r.rulename,pg_get_ruledef(r.oid)) order by n.nspname,c.relname,r.rulename),'[]') from pg_rewrite r join pg_class c on c.oid=r.ev_class join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema'),
 'extensions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e.extname,e.extversion,n.nspname,pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)) order by e.extname) from pg_extension e join pg_namespace n on n.oid=e.extnamespace),
 'types',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,t.typname,t.typtype,pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),t.typacl,t.typnotnull,t.typdefault,(select jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel order by e.enumsortorder) from pg_enum e where e.enumtypid=t.oid)) order by n.nspname,t.typname),'[]') from pg_type t join pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace where n.nspname not like 'pg_%' and n.nspname<>'information_schema' and t.typtype in ('e','d')),
 'ledgerText',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name,'statements',statements) order by version collate "C")::text,'[]') from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
 'ledgerDescriptor',jsonb_build_object(
  'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull) order by a.attnum) from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid='supabase_migrations.schema_migrations'::regclass and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
  'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(pg_get_constraintdef(oid) order by conname) from pg_constraint where conrelid='supabase_migrations.schema_migrations'::regclass),

 'effective',(select jsonb_object_agg(rolname,has_function_privilege(oid,to_regprocedure('public.review_chapter_practice_binding(uuid,uuid,integer,jsonb,boolean)'),'EXECUTE')) from pg_roles where rolname in ('postgres','authenticated','service_role','anon'))
);

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'extensions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e.extname,e.extversion,n.nspname,pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)) ORDER BY e.extname),'[]') FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace),
 'plpgsqlLanguage',(SELECT jsonb_build_array(l.lanname,pg_get_userbyid(l.lanowner),l.lanpltrusted,l.lanacl::text,lh.proname,ih.proname,vh.proname) FROM pg_language l LEFT JOIN pg_proc lh ON lh.oid=l.lanplcallfoid LEFT JOIN pg_proc ih ON ih.oid=l.laninline LEFT JOIN pg_proc vh ON vh.oid=l.lanvalidator WHERE l.lanname='plpgsql'),
 'members',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(i.type,i.schema,i.name,i.identity,d.objsubid) ORDER BY i.type,i.schema,i.name,i.identity,d.objsubid),'[]') FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) i WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' AND e.extname='plpgsql'),
 'implementation',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes),pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proacl::text,p.prokind,p.prorettype::regtype::text,p.proretset,p.prosecdef,p.proisstrict,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,p.proleakproof,l.lanname,p.prosrc,p.probin,p.proconfig,p.proargnames,p.proargmodes) ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)),'[]') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.objsubid=0 AND d.deptype='e' AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE e.extname='plpgsql'));

WITH members AS (
 SELECT e.extname,d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid,i.type,i.schema,i.identity,
 CASE d.classid WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN p.proowner WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN t.typowner
 WHEN 'pg_operator'::regclass THEN o.oprowner WHEN 'pg_opclass'::regclass THEN c.opcowner
 WHEN 'pg_opfamily'::regclass THEN f.opfowner END AS ownerid,
 CASE d.classid WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN p.proacl WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN t.typacl END AS rawacl,
 CASE d.classid
 WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'kind',p.prokind,'returnType',p.prorettype::regtype::text,'set',p.proretset,'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'strict',p.proisstrict,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',(SELECT lanname FROM pg_language WHERE oid=p.prolang),'src',p.prosrc,'bin',p.probin,'config',p.proconfig,'argnames',p.proargnames,'argmodes',p.proargmodes,'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),'cost',p.procost,'rows',p.prorows)
 WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('type',t.typtype,'category',t.typcategory,'defined',t.typisdefined,'len',t.typlen,'byval',t.typbyval,'align',t.typalign,'storage',t.typstorage,'input',t.typinput::regprocedure::text,'output',t.typoutput::regprocedure::text,'receive',t.typreceive::regprocedure::text,'send',t.typsend::regprocedure::text,'typmodin',t.typmodin::regprocedure::text,'typmodout',t.typmodout::regprocedure::text,'analyze',t.typanalyze::regprocedure::text,'subscript',t.typsubscript::regprocedure::text,'element',t.typelem::regtype::text,'array',t.typarray::regtype::text,'base',t.typbasetype::regtype::text,'notnull',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault)
 WHEN 'pg_operator'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('kind',o.oprkind,'merge',o.oprcanmerge,'hash',o.oprcanhash,'left',o.oprleft::regtype::text,'right',o.oprright::regtype::text,'result',o.oprresult::regtype::text,'code',o.oprcode::regprocedure::text,'commutator',o.oprcom::regoperator::text,'negator',o.oprnegate::regoperator::text,'restrict',o.oprrest::regprocedure::text,'join',o.oprjoin::regprocedure::text)
 WHEN 'pg_opclass'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('method',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=c.opcmethod),'family',(SELECT format('%I.%I',n.nspname,q.opfname) FROM pg_opfamily q JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=q.opfnamespace WHERE q.oid=c.opcfamily),'input',c.opcintype::regtype::text,'key',c.opckeytype::regtype::text,'default',c.opcdefault)
 WHEN 'pg_opfamily'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('method',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=f.opfmethod),'operators',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.amoplefttype::regtype::text,a.amoprighttype::regtype::text,a.amopstrategy,a.amoppurpose,a.amopopr::regoperator::text) ORDER BY a.amoplefttype::regtype::text,a.amoprighttype::regtype::text,a.amopstrategy),'[]') FROM pg_amop a WHERE a.amopfamily=f.oid),'procedures',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.amproclefttype::regtype::text,a.amprocrighttype::regtype::text,a.amprocnum,a.amproc::regprocedure::text) ORDER BY a.amproclefttype::regtype::text,a.amprocrighttype::regtype::text,a.amprocnum),'[]') FROM pg_amproc a WHERE a.amprocfamily=f.oid))
 END AS structure
 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) i
 LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND p.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_type t ON d.classid='pg_type'::regclass AND t.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_operator o ON d.classid='pg_operator'::regclass AND o.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_opclass c ON d.classid='pg_opclass'::regclass AND c.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_opfamily f ON d.classid='pg_opfamily'::regclass AND f.oid=d.objid
 WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' AND e.extname<>'plpgsql'
), aclmembers AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN classid='pg_proc'::regclass THEN 'f' ELSE 'T' END::"char" AS defaulttype FROM members WHERE classid IN ('pg_proc'::regclass,'pg_type'::regclass))
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'extensions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner),'relocatable',e.extrelocatable,'dependencies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.extname ORDER BY x.extname),'[]') FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension x ON x.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.objid=e.oid AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass),'configTables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x::regclass::text ORDER BY ord) FROM unnest(e.extconfig) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(x,ord)),'conditions',e.extcondition) ORDER BY e.extname),'[]') FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace WHERE e.extname<>'plpgsql'),
 'members',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('extension',extname,'class',classid::regclass::text,'objectType',type,'schema',schema,'identity',identity,'subid',objsubid,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),'structure',structure) ORDER BY extname,classid::regclass::text,identity,objsubid),'[]') FROM members),
 'rawAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(extname,classid::regclass::text,identity,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),rawacl) ORDER BY extname,classid::regclass::text,identity),'[]') FROM aclmembers),
 'expandedAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable),'[]') FROM aclmembers m CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(m.rawacl,acldefault(m.defaulttype,m.ownerid))) a),
 'effective',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,r.rolname,CASE WHEN m.classid='pg_proc'::regclass THEN has_function_privilege(r.oid,m.objid,'EXECUTE') ELSE has_type_privilege(r.oid,m.objid,'USAGE') END) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,r.rolname),'[]') FROM aclmembers m CROSS JOIN pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname<>'uply_owned_restore_admin'),
 'initialPrivileges',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('extension',m.extname,'class',m.classid::regclass::text,'identity',m.identity,'subid',ip.objsubid,'origin',ip.privtype,'raw',ip.initprivs,'expanded',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type) FROM aclexplode(ip.initprivs) a)) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,ip.objsubid),'[]') FROM members m JOIN pg_init_privs ip ON ip.classoid=m.classid AND ip.objoid=m.objid)
);

WITH owners(kind,ident,ownerid) AS (
 SELECT 'namespace',nspname::text,nspowner FROM pg_namespace
 WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,c.relowner
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',p.proowner
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE (n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema')
 OR p.oid IN (SELECT objid FROM pg_depend WHERE classid='pg_proc'::regclass
 AND refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND deptype='e'
 AND refobjid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='plpgsql'))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,t.typowner
 FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'extension',extname::text,extowner FROM pg_extension
 UNION ALL SELECT 'language',lanname::text,lanowner FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default',oid::text,defaclrole FROM pg_default_acl
), acls(kind,ident,acl) AS (
 SELECT 'namespace',nspname::text,nspacl FROM pg_namespace
 WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,c.relacl FROM pg_class c
 JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attname,a.attacl
 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',p.proacl
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE (n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema')
 OR p.oid IN (SELECT objid FROM pg_depend WHERE classid='pg_proc'::regclass
 AND refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND deptype='e'
 AND refobjid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='plpgsql'))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,t.typacl FROM pg_type t
 JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default',oid::text,defaclacl FROM pg_default_acl
 UNION ALL SELECT 'language',lanname::text,lanacl FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'database',datname::text,datacl FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()
), refs AS (
 SELECT kind,ident,'owner'::text AS position,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid)::text AS role FROM owners
 UNION ALL SELECT kind,ident,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor)::text
 FROM acls CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(acl) a
 UNION ALL SELECT kind,ident,'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END
 FROM acls CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(acl) a
 UNION ALL SELECT 'membership',roleid::text||':'||member::text,'role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid)::text FROM pg_auth_members
 UNION ALL SELECT 'membership',roleid::text||':'||member::text,'member',pg_get_userbyid(member)::text FROM pg_auth_members
 UNION ALL SELECT 'membership',roleid::text||':'||member::text,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(grantor)::text FROM pg_auth_members
 UNION ALL SELECT 'policy',polname::text,'role',pg_get_userbyid(r)::text
 FROM pg_policy CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(polroles) r WHERE r<>0
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'owners',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(kind,ident,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid)) ORDER BY kind,ident) FROM owners),
 'acls',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(kind,ident,acl::text) ORDER BY kind,ident) FROM acls),
 'expandedAcl',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(kind,ident,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY kind,ident,a.grantor,a.grantee,a.privilege_type) FROM acls CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(acl) a),
 'extensionMembers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('extension',e.extname,'class',d.classid::regclass::text,'description',pg_describe_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid)) ORDER BY e.extname,d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e'),
 'databaseOwner',(SELECT pg_get_userbyid(datdba) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
);
